description: Consent is obtained without providing data subjects with adequate information about the processing. Article 7 requires informed consent, meaning data subjects must know identity of controller, purposes, and other Article 13/14 information.
applicability: Applicable when obtaining consent for processing. Data subjects must receive all required transparency information before or at the time of consent to make informed decision.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of consent mechanisms and absence of required information at point of consent collection.
